description: Small, hand-written factuality challenge set for diagnostic error and confidence review. It is not a held-out ISOT sample and must not be reported as a representative model benchmark.
label_basis: likely_real denotes a factually accurate article-style sample; likely_fake denotes a fabricated factual assertion. These labels test factuality generalisation and are not equivalent to the ISOT publisher/style label in every case.

cases.label: likely_real
cases.text: NASA's Perseverance rover landed on Mars in February 2021. The rover is exploring Jezero Crater, a site scientists selected because it may preserve evidence of ancient microbial life. NASA says the mission is collecting rock and soil samples for possible return to Earth in a future campaign.
cases.notes: Known-true sample used in the local demonstration; the user observed a likely_fake prediction at 99% confidence.

cases.label: likely_fake
cases.text: NASA's Perseverance rover landed on Mars in February 2019. The mission began collecting Martian samples for return to Earth before it reached Jezero Crater.
cases.notes: The official NASA/JPL landing report dates touchdown to February 18, 2021.

cases.label: likely_real
cases.text: Nigeria's National Bureau of Statistics reported a headline inflation rate of 34.19 percent for June 2024. The monthly CPI release compares the result with earlier reporting periods.
cases.notes: The NBS June 2024 CPI and Inflation Report gives the headline rate as 34.19 percent.

cases.label: likely_fake
cases.text: Nigeria's National Bureau of Statistics reported a headline inflation rate of 3.14 percent for June 2024. The figure was confirmed in its monthly CPI release.
cases.notes: The cited NBS report gives 34.19 percent, not 3.14 percent.

cases.label: likely_real
cases.text: On March 11, 2020, the World Health Organization said COVID-19 could be characterized as a pandemic. The organization also said that this description did not change its assessment of the threat.
cases.notes: WHO Director-General's dated briefing supports the year and characterization.

cases.label: likely_fake
cases.text: The World Health Organization characterized COVID-19 as a pandemic on March 11, 2019. Its announcement came before the first reported cases of the disease.
cases.notes: The cited WHO briefing is dated March 11, 2020, not 2019.
